* '''Errata''': [[Zuckuss (V) (Errata)]] — Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. If present (or piloting an [Independent] starship) during battle, may make a just drawn destiny = the printed destiny of the top card of opponent's Lost Pile. Immune to attrition &lt; 2 + the number of weapon destiny draws that were completed this battle.
